name: Q4 Product Growth OKR
description: A business OKR expressed as a GOAL model: reduce churn through product reliability and customer success.

states.description: Monthly customer churn is 4.2%; NPS is 31; support backlog grows week over week.
Monthly churn is at or below 2.5% and NPS is at or above 45.

goals.statement: Reduce monthly customer churn from 4.2% to at most 2.5% by end of Q4.

successCriteria.description: Monthly customer retention is at least 97.5% for the final month of Q4 (equivalent to churn <= 2.5%).

goals.statement: Resolve the top five causes of customer-reported reliability complaints.

successCriteria.description: Each of the top 5 complaint causes from Q3 analysis has a closed ticket with a verified fix.
Product uptime for the quarter is at least 99.9%.

goals.statement: Deduplicate customer records in the churn data pipeline.

successCriteria.description: Data quality check reports zero duplicate customer records for two consecutive weekly runs.

goals.statement: Every new customer completes guided onboarding within 14 days of signup.

successCriteria.description: At least 85% of cohorts signing up in Q4 finish onboarding within 14 days.

obstacles.description: Churn metrics rely on a data pipeline with known duplication issues, risking miscounted churn.
Company-wide hiring freeze limits engineering capacity for reliability work.
